ul.li: Upload a .zip containing one or more Odoo modules, each with its own technical folder name at the top, e.g. my_module/__manifest__.py.

This closes right away: the zip is extracted, protected, compiled and re-zipped in the background (a scheduled action) — go to Settings > Source Code Protector to watch progress, and you'll get a notification when it's done.
If your zip is password-protected, enter the password below — the protected output zip will be encrypted with the same password.

form.div: ⚠ Platform notice: Compiled binaries (.so/.pyd) are platform-locked. The protected module will only run on this Odoo server, or another server with the same Python version, same OS, and same CPU architecture. Always install and test the protected module on a staging database before production.

field.name: password
field.placeholder: Leave blank if zip is not encrypted
